Subject: ACME - cash application extract and notes

Internal only (finance ops):

I pulled the cash-application log for ACME-REF-7782. System exceptions: VAT_CODE_MISMATCH on invoices 4582/4583. Auto-match matched amounts but failed the tax validation step — posted the payment to unapplied cash.

I attached a working csv (cash-application-may.csv) showing: invoice_id, invoice_amount, invoice_vat, payment_amount, unapplied_amount, match_status. Notes:
- Invoice 4590 has a net/VAT split that doesn't equal the remittance breakdown (EUR 1,200 difference).
- Our collector set VAT at invoice-level (VAT included), looks like ACME posted as passthrough on their bank side (no VAT amount in bank metadata).

Plan:
- If Acme confirms they intended passthrough, we'll post a reversing VAT accrual (je reversing AR VAT) and reapply cash as net.
- If Acme confirms VAT was withheld, we'll apply the payment and book VAT receivable for the withheld amount, then follow up for a withholding tax credit.

I'll hold on manual application until we get final confirmation. Filing ticket: AR-2234.

Marcus
Senior AR Analyst | Redwood Inference

Let us know when you've posted and what residual (if any) remains so we can reconcile on our end.

Thanks,
Acme Payments Team
